items.title: Rescuers search rubble for survivors as Venezuela earthquakes kill at least 235
items.description: At least 4,300 people have been injured after two seven-plus magnitude shallow quakes hit seconds apart.

items.title: Earthquake is devastating blow to Venezuela at time of uncertainty
items.description: The twin quakes come less than six months after Venezuela's then-leader Nicolás Maduro was seized by US forces.

items.title: People flee as building collapses on Caracas outskirts
items.description: The capital and its surrounding areas have seen some of the worst damage from the 7.2 and 7.5 quakes, which hit a minute apart.

items.title: UN pauses Strait of Hormuz evacuation plan after cargo ship attacked
items.description: The ship was reportedly struck by an "unknown projectile" near Oman but no casualties were reported.

items.title: Women alleging rape and sexual assault in France call to abolish statute of limitations
items.description: More than 50 women are calling for the abolition of the statute of limitations which they say has prevented them seeking justice.

items.title: Supreme Court allows Trump to end protected status for Haitian and Syrian immigrants
items.description: The ruling opens the path for the Trump administration to deport hundreds of thousands of immigrants who have been living in the US for years.

items.title: Reflecting Pool liner cut with sharp knife or razor, National Park Service says
items.description: Earlier in the week Donald Trump blamed vandals for "a 300 foot long gash" in the pool and accused someone of putting fertiliser in the water.

items.title: Asia stock markets slide as tech shares slump
items.description: Trading on South Korea's Kospi index was halted for the third time this week to prevent panic selling.

items.title: Housing board votes to freeze New York rents in victory for Mamdani
items.description: The decision was welcomed by many tenants - but landlords fear it will worsen housing conditions.

items.title: Row over alleged theft of donations from India's landmark Ram temple
items.description: Questions are being raised over the handling of cash, valuable jewellery, gold and silver offered by devotees.

items.title: Paris restricts alcohol consumption and sales as Europe's heatwave shifts east
items.description: Temperatures in Germany could hit 40C in some areas while French officials bring in alcohol restrictions to ease pressure on hospitals.

items.title: Trump asks Congress for billions for Iran war, after tension with Republicans
items.description: But the budget faces an uphill battle as the president spars with some members of his own party over the issue.
